scope: Field Collector PostgreSQL consent eligibility view
method: Synthetic location, party, reviewed required-consent form revision, participant link, grant, withdrawal, regrant, and collection inserted inside one explicit PostgreSQL transaction; assertions ran against the real view and the transaction ended with ROLLBACK.

assertions.scenario: Collection synchronized under a valid active grant
Consent withdrawn after collection, then granted again

limitations: This verifies the PostgreSQL view only; it does not exercise the API route or browser consent UI.
Human retention/erasure disposition, tenant/RLS, real OIDC, and OS airplane-mode/Gateway recovery remain open.
rollback: The database transaction was explicitly rolled back; no runtime or migration rollback is required.
